### Sentenced to Death
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/sentenced-death
Passage: Matthew 27:24-26
Points:
- Pilate recognized Jesus' innocence but abandoned justice out of fear of a civil riot.
- Washing his hands was a futile attempt to escape personal guilt for executing an innocent man.
- The crowd preferred Barabbas because they wanted a violent political revolutionary rather than a humble Messiah.
- Shifting blame to the crowd does not absolve Pilate, nor does the crowd's response justify prejudice against Jewish people.
- All humanity bears responsibility for Christ's death because our sins made His sacrifice necessary, which He endured willingly by God's grace.
